# Repository Instructions

Before changing code, tests, configuration, or documentation, open and follow:

- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution workflow and
  sensitive data handling.
- [`docs/STYLE.md`](../docs/STYLE.md) for repository conventions.
- [`docs/SETUP.md`](../docs/SETUP.md) for tools and validation commands.

Checked-in configuration and tests take precedence if either guide drifts.
